title: 第477章 如何全歼敌人
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“喵喵～”

静谧的山林间，

月华灵猫鼻尖轻嗅，循着风中残留的人类气息，最终在一处极其隐蔽的山地驻足。

林奇和杰克藏在树梢上，看着远处零散走过的身影和房屋建筑。

毫无疑问，这里就是火护山的一个据点。

“杰克，你觉得该用什么办法，才能让其他两个寨子的人过来支援呢？”

林奇打量着下方戒备森严的山寨，问出心中所想。

他一直在思考该如何将这些强盗一网打尽。

可这里太大，寨子分布又远，仅凭他们两个人，难度不是一般的大。

若是他全力爆发、以绝对战力横推此处据点。

显露的实力太强，剩余两寨的强盗说不定会分头逃窜，再想清剿便是大海捞针。

和这里打个持久战，其他两个寨子过来支援的几率有，但这操作性太难。

而且他这边就两个人。

一个寨子的人打两个人迟迟不能拿下，生性多疑的人肯定能察觉到问题。

“那个山贼说过，摩罗斯生性狡诈、谨慎多疑，如果我们展现出太强的实力，他可能看到就逃了，所以必须用其他办法。”

杰克目光紧锁下方山寨，分析道。

“这几个寨子是他们的大本营，

遇到强敌来袭，寨子里的人自知打不过，一定会离开这里去外面躲藏。

等到风波过了，再回到寨子内，这是山贼强盗的天性。

可若是有一群人直接占领了这个寨子，并且是永久性的占领，就不知道他们会不会拼死抵抗了……”

永久性占领？

林奇微微一怔，觉得杰克说的很有道理。

“摩罗斯既然在这里练兵，那么他绝对不会舍弃这里。

只要断他们根基、夺他们据点，为了守住心血与地盘，他必然会倾尽三寨人手，全员死战反扑。”

“可我们就两个人，又不可能一直呆在这里，怎么占领？”

二人相视一眼，陷入了沉思。

“吱吱~”

就在这时，

一只土黄色的地鼠从地底钻出，探头探脑，警惕张望四周。

确认无险后，转瞬又钻入土层消失不见。

这寻常的一幕像惊雷般惊醒了二人。

“兽潮？”

两人几乎是异口同声，声音豁然开朗。

“是了，就是兽潮！”

杰克眼中精光一闪。

“火护山本就被卡兽泛滥，尤其还火护犬占领过，就说明此地完全有可能会发生兽潮。”

林奇也是点头认可。

“既然他们在此地盘踞多年，甚至还清扫了周围的卡兽和火护犬。

那就说明他们有对付卡兽的经验，甚至还可能应对过几次兽潮。

Page (1/3)

"Meow meow~"

In the quiet mountains and forests,

The Yuehua Civet sniffed lightly with the tip of its nose, following the residual human scent in the wind, and finally stopped in an extremely secluded mountainous area.

Lynch and Jack hid in the treetops, watching the scattered figures and houses passing by in the distance.

There is no doubt that this is a stronghold of Huohu Mountain.

"Jack, what do you think we should do to get people from the other two villages to come over and support us?"

Lin Qi looked at the heavily guarded cottage below and asked what was on his mind.

He has been thinking about how to catch these bandits in one fell swoop.

But this place is too big, and the villages are spread far and wide. It would be extremely difficult for just the two of them.

If he breaks out with all his strength and uses his absolute combat power to overthrow this stronghold.

The revealed strength is too strong, and the bandits in the remaining two villages may flee separately, and any attempt to eliminate them will be like finding a needle in a haystack.

If we fight a protracted battle here, there is a chance that the other two villages will come to support us, but this is too difficult to operate.

And there are only two people on his side.

People from one village can't win even if they beat two people. People who are suspicious by nature will definitely be able to detect the problem.

"The bandit said that Moros is cunning, cautious and suspicious by nature. If we show too much strength, he may run away when he sees us, so we must use other methods."

Jack's eyes were fixed on the cottage below and he analyzed.

“These villages are their base camps.

When a powerful enemy attacks, the people in the village will definitely leave and hide outside if they know they can't defeat them.

It is the nature of bandits and robbers to wait until the storm is over before returning to the village.

But if a group of people directly occupied this village and occupied it permanently, I don’t know if they would resist desperately..."

Permanent occupation?

Lin Qi was slightly startled and felt that what Jack said made sense.

“Since Moros is training here, he will never abandon this place.

As long as he cuts off their foundation and seizes their stronghold, in order to defend his hard work and territory, he will definitely use all the men of the three villages to fight to the death."

"But there are only two of us, and we can't stay here forever. How can we occupy it?"

The two looked at each other and fell into deep thought.

"Zhizhi~"

Just then,

A khaki-colored gopher emerged from the ground, probing its head and looking around cautiously.

After confirming that there was no danger, he immediately burrowed into the soil and disappeared.

This ordinary scene awakened the two of them like thunder.

"Tide of beasts?"

The two of them spoke almost in unison, and their voices suddenly became clearer.

"Yes, it's a tide of beasts!"

Jack's eyes flashed.

"Huohu Mountain has been overrun by card beasts, especially since Fire Guard Dogs have occupied it, which shows that it is entirely possible for a beast tide to occur here."

Lynch also nodded in approval.

“Since they have been entrenched here for many years, they have even cleared away the Ka beasts and Fire Guard Dogs around.

That means they have experience in dealing with card beasts, and may even have dealt with beast tides several times.
